system.description:
This talent gives no special effects to a missile when shot. If left in a container with other missiles of the same type (that is, a refilling arrow with normal arrows or a refilling sling stone with normal sling stones), however, it will magically create [[/r 1d20 #Normal missiles created]] more missiles of the normal type each day.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Ammunition for a sling. These sling stones/pellets are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
